provenance_quote: EspP, a novel extracellular serine protease of enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli O157:H7 cleaves human coagulation factor V
notes: DOI=Brunder 1997 Mol Microbiol resolves via Crossref (title quoted). UniProt Q7BSW5=espP, E. coli O157:H7, annotated autotransporter, Secreted/Cell surface, passenger 56-1023, locus ECO57PM78 (ledger pO157p78). T5aSS passenger is the secreted substrate. Identity correct.

provenance_quote: The Major Phase-Variable Outer Membrane Protein of Escherichia coli Structurally Resembles the Immunoglobulin A1 Protease Class of Exported Protein
notes: DOI=Henderson and Owen 1999 J Bacteriol resolves via Crossref (title quoted). UniProt P39180=flu/Antigen 43, E. coli K12, locus b2000, autotransporter family, surface-displayed alpha chain. T5aSS passenger. Ledger citation_quote is a paraphrase but the ref supports the exported-autotransporter claim.

provenance_quote: The precursor contains three functional domains, the amino-terminal leader ... the protease, and a carboxyl-terminal helper domain apparently required for extracellular secretion (excretion).
notes: primary_ref 10.1038/325458a0 = Pohlner 1987 Nature (PMID 3027577), the prototype IgA-protease autotransporter, is on N. gonorrhoeae; row organism/UniProt is N. meningitidis. UniProt Q51163=iga, N. meningitidis strain 81139 taxid 487, IgA1 protease autotransporter, Secreted. Shared IgA-protease autotransporter secretion mechanism; meningitidis identity matches. Cited-ref organism differs from row organism, hence medium.

provenance_quote: We have identified and characterized a secreted protein, designated Pic, which is encoded on the chromosomes of enteroaggregative Escherichia coli (EAEC) 042 and Shigella flexneri 2457T.
notes: DOI=Henderson 1999 Infect Immun (PMID 10531204) resolves; abstract verbatim matches ledger quote. UniProt Q7BS42=pic SPATE serine protease autotransporter, E. coli O44:H18 strain 042, locus EC042_4593 (ledger EC042_RS24520 RefSeq form). T5aSS passenger secreted. Identity correct.

provenance_quote: Sat, a vacuolating cytotoxin expressed by uropathogenic E. coli CFT073, elicits defined damage to kidney epithelium during upper urinary tract infection
notes: DOI=Guyer 2002 Infect Immun (PMID 12117966) resolves; abstract verbatim matches ledger quote. UniProt Q8FDW4=sat secreted autotransporter toxin, E. coli CFT073, ordered locus c3619 (ledger C_RS17200 RefSeq form). T5aSS passenger secreted. Identity correct.

provenance_quote: Upon cell contact, the toxic C-terminus of the TpsA family member CdiA, called the CdiA-CT, inhibits the growth of CDI(-) bacteria. ... bcpAIOB define a novel class of TPS system.
notes: DOI=Anderson and Cotter 2012 PLoS Genet (PMID 22912595) resolves. BcpA is the TpsA-family exoprotein of a Burkholderia two-partner secretion (T5bSS) CDI system, secreted via TpsB BcpB. No UniProt in ledger (na). Locus BTH_RS26080, B. thailandensis E264. Secretion claim supported.

provenance_quote: Bacterial contact-dependent growth inhibition (CDI) is mediated by the CdiB/CdiA family of two-partner secretion proteins.
notes: DOI=Webb 2013 PLoS One (PMID 23469034) resolves; abstract verbatim matches ledger. UniProt Q0T963=cdiA tRNA nuclease, E. coli UPEC 536, ordered locus ECP_4580 (ledger ECP_RS23250 RefSeq form). CdiA is the TpsA exoprotein of T5bSS, secreted via CdiB. Identity correct.

provenance_quote: CdrA shares structural similarities to extracellular adhesins that belong to two-partner secretion systems. ... CdrA is produced as a 220 kDa proprotein and processed to 150 kDa before secretion into the extracellular medium.
notes: DOI=Borlee 2010 Mol Microbiol (PMID 20088866) resolves; abstract verbatim matches ledger quote. CdrA (PA4625, P. aeruginosa PAO1) is a TPS-secreted adhesin (T5bSS), partner CdrB. No UniProt in ledger (na). Secretion claim supported.

provenance_quote: Amino-terminal maturation of the Bordetella pertussis filamentous haemagglutinin
notes: DOI=Jacob-Dubuisson 1996 Mol Microbiol resolves via Crossref (title quoted). UniProt P12255=fhaB filamentous hemagglutinin, B. pertussis Tohama I, locus BP1879 (ledger BP_RS09365 RefSeq form); UniProt: secreted to cell surface by FhaC TPS partner. FhaB is the prototypical TpsA exoprotein (T5bSS). Identity correct.

provenance_quote: In order to facilitate interaction with host cells, HMW1 and HMW2 are localized on the surface of the organism ... HMW1B is located in the outer membrane and serves to translocate HMW1 across the outer membrane.
notes: DOI=St Geme and Grass 1998 Mol Microbiol (PMID 9489673) resolves; abstract supports surface localization/secretion of HMW1 via OM translocator HMW1B (TPS T5bSS). HMW1A (locus R2846_RS03620, H. influenzae R2846) is the secreted exoprotein; HMW1B is TpsB. No UniProt in ledger (na). Secretion claim supported.

provenance_quote: NH2-terminal amino acid sequence analysis of purified extracellular hemolysin (HpmA) confirmed the cleavage of the 29-amino-acid leader peptide in the secreted form of HpmA. ... HpmB is necessary for the extracellular secretion and activation of HpmA.
notes: DOI=Uphoff and Welch 1990 J Bacteriol (PMID 2407716) resolves; abstract supports HpmA as extracellular/secreted TPS hemolysin (HpmB=TpsB). UniProt B4F0Z9=hpmA hemolysin, P. mirabilis HI4320, locus PMI2057 (ledger PMI_RS10140 RefSeq form), FhaB/CdiA-like TPS domain. NOTE: ledger citation_quote (FhaC unable to mediate secretion of HpmA) is NOT in this 1990 sequence-only paper; it is misattributed, but DOI/protein/ss_type are correct and secretion IS supported by this ref via the quoted sentence. Medium for quote misattribution.

provenance_quote: Structure of the secretion domain of HxuA from Haemophilus influenzae
notes: DOI=Baelen 2013 Acta Cryst F resolves via Crossref (title quoted). UniProt P44602=hxuA heme/hemopexin-binding protein, H. influenzae Rd KW20, locus HI_0264 (ledger HI_RS01415 RefSeq form), TPS domain PF05860, secreted precursor. HxuA is the TpsA exoprotein secreted by TpsB HxuB (T5bSS). Identity correct.

provenance_quote: This inhibitory effect of wild-type H. ducreyi on phagocytic activity ... could also be found, under certain conditions, in concentrated H. ducreyi culture supernatant fluids that lacked detectable outer membrane fragments.
notes: DOI=Vakevainen 2003 Infect Immun (PMID 14500520) resolves; abstract documents LspA activity in culture supernatant (secreted). UniProt Q7VLE8=lspA1 Large supernatant protein 1, H. ducreyi 35000HP, locus HD_1505 (ledger HD_RS06155 RefSeq form), FhaB/CdiA-like TPS domain. LspA1 is a TPS-secreted exoprotein (T5bSS). Identity correct.

provenance_quote: This inhibitory effect of wild-type H. ducreyi on phagocytic activity ... could also be found, under certain conditions, in concentrated H. ducreyi culture supernatant fluids that lacked detectable outer membrane fragments.
notes: DOI=Vakevainen 2003 Infect Immun (PMID 14500520) resolves; abstract covers both LspA1 and LspA2, documents secretion to culture supernatant.
